comment: Plan 036 WP-0's reviewed inert list (tier-2 data; plan036_wp0/scan.py). A target here touches nothing outside the process's memory. Keyed by fully qualified target, or (types) by class for a closed set of in-memory types whose every method is inert (only `<json>` since review round 2: a whole-type entry would also cover methods that run other objects' code; every other type is listed method by method, a method that runs code of its arguments or elements only with a protocol rule in scan.py). A wrong entry hides an edge: that is the residual the plan names.

types.reason: a value json.loads/json.load produced (dict, list, str, int, float, bool or None), proved by plan036_wp0/json_origin.py: every method of those types is in-memory

targets.reason: Constructors and functions of built-in types that compute in memory

Constructors and functions of built-in types that compute in memory. These run an argument's or element's protocol methods, or call back a callable they are handed: in memory for in-memory operands, and scan.py resolves each such protocol at every call (METHOD_PROTOCOLS, the iteration, conversion and attribute rules), so an unknown operand is an unresolvable site (review round 3 audit)
